text:
on writing, u really dont need a high hit rate

there are 700-page books where I only recall one sentence or phrase...yet that one changed my entire life. so, it was worth it.

works both ways

ur output can be 99% blah, 1% fantastic

but the output or "tonnage," has to be there.

quotedTweet.text:
good term from Seinfeld, on writing: "Game of Tonnage"

"No one’s that great. You know who’s great? The people that just put tremendous amount of hours into it. It’s a game of tonnage." [Tim Ferris intvw/2020]

get ur reps...bc "if you dont write clearly, you dont think clearly."
